name: Nestle munch king size
ingredients: Sugar, Refined Wheat flour (Maida), Hydrogenated vegetable fats, Fractionated vegetable fat, Milk solids, Cocoa solids (3.8%), Emulsifiers (Soya lecithin and 476), Raising agent (500 ii), Yeast, Iodized salt, Flour treatment agent (516) and Artificial flavouring substances (vanilla). Allergen note: Contains Wheat, Milk, Sesame and Soy. May Contain Nuts.
